Then McKay, finishing with Odell, and this quartet are to be congratulated. Read has certainly strengthened our team.

Jock McKay showed a welcome return to form in gaining a place. The 1320 Yards saw Tommy Scrimshaw on the scratch mark and although considered a non-starter he raked together some togs and astounded us all by nearly catching his field on the first lap.

The Brothers McKAY,FRED STONE, JIMMY FLATT and MICK PYER came into the fold in 1921,and 1922 gave us WALLY BAYLISS (Hon. Secretary for eleven years and President for three), the incomparable BERT FOOTER, and champion walker HAROLD KING.
